privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.text:
"Guilds of the Deep" is a student project built as part of the École 42 Belgium program, currently hosted in a local environment (localhost) for educational purposes.

When you create an account, we only collect your email address and your password (stored encrypted/hashed). No other personal data is collected. The Service does not use any tracking cookies, any analytics tools, and does not rely on any third-party service (advertising, social media, payment, etc.).

Your email address and password are used exclusively to let you create an account and log in to the Service. This information is not used for any other purpose: no marketing emails, no sale or sharing with third parties, no profiling.

Your data is kept in the database for as long as your account exists. It is deleted if you request the deletion of your account, or if the project stops being maintained (end of the school curriculum).

Your data is not shared with any third party. It remains accessible only to the project's development team, strictly for the purpose of technical maintenance of the Service.

In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to access, correct, and delete your data. To exercise these rights, contact any of the team members listed above.

We implement reasonable measures to protect your data (hashed passwords, restricted database access). As the Service is a student project under development, production-level security is not guaranteed.

This policy may be updated while the project is in development. The date at the top of this page reflects the latest version in effect.

For any question about this policy or your data, write to any of the team members listed above.

terms_of_service.title: Terms of Service
terms_of_service.text:
"Guilds of the Deep" (the "Service") is a student project developed as part of the École 42 Belgium program. The Service is currently in development and hosted in a local environment (localhost) for educational, non-commercial purposes.

By creating an account on the Service, you agree to these Terms of Service and the accompanying Privacy Policy. If you do not agree to these terms, you should not use the Service.

Creating an account requires a valid email address and a password. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for any activity carried out from your account.

The Service is a student project provided "as is", with no guarantee of availability, continuity, or absence of bugs. It may be interrupted, reset, or deleted at any time without notice, in particular at the end of the school curriculum.

You agree to use the Service reasonably and to not attempt to compromise its operation (unauthorized access, exploitation of vulnerabilities, etc.).

You may request the deletion of your account and your data at any time by contacting any of the team members listed above.

These terms may be updated at any time while the project is in development. The date at the top of this page reflects the latest version in effect.

For any question about these terms, you can reach any of the team members listed above.
